title: Unify checkout and wallet idempotency
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Unified the actual browser key lifecycle in Apollo, required and fingerprint-bound direct wallet keys, routed all current wallet callers through one shared boundary, normalized concurrent duplicate-key races to the same business error contract, and added targeted regression contracts. Targeted tests, GraphQL validation, and build were not executed because this connector session has no runnable checkout; GitHub reported no workflow runs or statuses for the final wallet-boundary code commit.
